title: The filtered empty state offers a way to clear the filters
refs: Filters (no Jira epic) (S8-R4 (the empty state includes a prompt or link to clear filters); S8-R5 (where a query is also active each is cleared independently)) [spec v1.6 2026-07-28]
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Work Orders page showing the filtered empty state (a filter combination matching no work orders is applied).
3. The page's own Search box is empty (no text typed in it).
custom_steps:
1. Read the empty state content.
2. Click the clear-filters prompt/link inside the empty state.
3. Look at the table and the chips.
custom_expected:
1. The empty state includes a prompt or link to clear the filters.
2. Clicking it removes the active filters and the full work order list is shown again (with no text in the Search box, nothing else is narrowing the list).
3. The chips return to their default state.
